patterns.note: The hero section utilizes a split-screen layout with a prominent left-aligned text block overlaying a lifestyle image, contrasted with a product-focused image on the right.
The site employs a muted, earthy color palette for its product photography and background elements, creating a natural and sophisticated feel, occasionally punctuated by subtle brand blue accents.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the left lifestyle image scrolls at a slightly different rate than the right product image, creating depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Product and category sections are presented in horizontal carousels, allowing for a broad display of items without excessive vertical scrolling, indicated by navigation arrows.
Headings are set in a clean, modern sans-serif with generous letter-spacing, maintaining a strong visual presence without being overly bold, complementing the aspirational photography.

technique_notes: The primary navigation and a promotional banner at the very top of the page stick to the top of the viewport after initial scroll, with the promotional banner shrinking in height to optimize screen real estate.
The hero section implements a subtle parallax scroll effect where background elements move at a slower rate than foreground elements, enhancing the sense of depth.

Content sections below the hero are revealed with a simple slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth transition between content blocks. Horizontal product carousels are powered by a library like Swiper, allowing users to navigate through product listings.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are clean sans-serifs, ranging from a very large hero title (~4x body) to smaller section titles (~1.5x body), all with consistent letter-spacing and a modern, legible character.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding is applied to buttons and some image containers, creating a soft, approachable feel without being overly rounded.
design_tokens.spacing: The layout is balanced, with airy spacing in the hero section and between major content blocks, transitioning to a more dense but still clear grid for product listings and footer elements.

standout: The site's distinctive use of aspirational, high-quality photography, particularly in the split-screen hero with subtle parallax, sets a sophisticated and premium tone. The muted, natural color palette derived from the imagery creates a cohesive and elevated brand experience.
